name: example_meeting_01
_comment: This is a schema template, not a real test case — evaluate.py skips files named TEMPLATE.json. Copy this file, rename it, and fill in real data to create an actual test case. All top-level sections are optional — include only the ones this test case is meant to cover.
_diarization_section_comment: Fill these in by hand-labeling a real meeting recording: listen to the audio and note exactly which speaker is talking during which time ranges (start/end in seconds). 'reference_segments' = your ground-truth labels. 'hypothesis_segments' = whatever your diarization backend (pyannote or legacy MFCC) actually output for the same audio — capture this by running the pipeline and copying its output here.
_summarization_section_comment: 'gold_summary' should be written by a human who actually listened to or read the meeting — not generated by any LLM, or ROUGE will just measure self-consistency. 'hypothesis_summary' is your pipeline's actual output for the same meeting.
gold_summary: The team approved the Q3 microservice migration and allocated $50,000 for GPU infrastructure. Priya will own the rollout timeline.
hypothesis_summary: PASTE YOUR PIPELINE'S REAL SUMMARIZATION OUTPUT HERE FOR THIS MEETING
_faithfulness_section_comment: 'transcript' is the real (or realistic) meeting transcript. 'extracted_claims' should include a MIX of true claims your pipeline correctly extracted AND at least one deliberately fabricated claim you inject yourself, each labeled with the correct is_hallucinated ground truth. This is what makes the faithfulness precision/recall numbers meaningful — without at least one true positive, precision/recall can't be computed at all (the script will report 'N/A' rather than a fake number).
transcript: Manager: Let's review the Q3 roadmap. Engineer: I think we should decouple the billing service first. Manager: Agreed, and we'll need budget for that. CEO: I'm approving fifty thousand dollars for GPU scaling to support this.

extracted_claims.text: The team approved $50,000 for GPU scaling.
The team approved a $200,000 marketing budget for Q4.
extracted_claims._comment: This is a deliberately injected fabrication — nothing in the transcript mentions marketing or Q4 budget. This is the test case that proves the faithfulness guard actually catches hallucinations rather than rubber-stamping everything.
